publisher_set: Our Show Is on Friday, Can You Make It? (2021 Secret Lair)
selection: All five cards enumerated in the publisher drop; all complete title fields manually fixed before any OCR runs. No OCR filtering or training.
normalization: NFC plus collapsed whitespace only; case, apostrophe and visible middle-dot separators are scored literally.
training_isolation: No name, Oracle ID or print ID appears in current English, Latin V1 or Latin V2 corpus selections/materialized manifests. Upstream pretrained-model membership is unknown.
scope: Hand-drawn Latin title lettering and its actual two-dimensional layout; rectangular crops retain incidental source pixels. Not a pure single-font classification benchmark.
rights: Original card imagery/lettering belongs to Wizards of the Coast and credited artists; frozen crop evidence is research data, not relicensed as MIT source code.
